animals.name: Pig
animals.description: Intelligent, empathetic, curious, with clear likes and dislikes; gets along well with other animals.

animals.name: Sugar Glider
animals.description: Gentle and affectionate toward owners; curious and may be shy at first, but becomes very attached once bonded.

animals.name: Cockroach
animals.description: Some are bold, while others are passive; personalities vary.

animals.name: Jerboa
animals.description: Curious, intelligent, social; can be sensitive or timid depending on the individual; personality may shift between pessimistic and optimistic depending on environment.

animals.name: Villager
animals.description: Hardworking, hateful of all players but are incredibly scared and subservient to them. Generally found in villages.

animals.name: Iron Golem
animals.description: Defender of Villagers, Generally found in villages. Will not attack unless Provoked
